BOSS BATTLE\nDefeat the Excavated Golem!
The strong light made the golem sluggish!
Now's your chance! Go go!!
Oh... You broke it down...\nYarn will be upset but there was no choice.\nIt was too dangerous.
Hm? What's wrong? ...The light?\nOh, you don't know [64ffff]Holy Gems[ffffff]?
You'd be in trouble without them if you face\nstrong monsters like that.\nTake some.
...How to use? Hmm, before that, we need to\nreport it to York and the others.\nWell, I'll tell you some time. Take care.
I really appreciate your help.\nBy the way, are you staying in Sofya City?\n...Then, we can meet soon.
I hope you can help me again then.\nSee you.
[64ffff]The holy gems[ffffff] that Balft gave you are [ffff64]support items\nfor boss battles[ffffff].
If you use the items, you can improve your stats\nor weaken boss monsters during the battle.
You can buy holy gems at general stores or create\nat synthesist.
Is there anything left undone?\n*[ffff64]Your choice makes no difference to the story[ffffff].
Nothing. Let's go out!
Explore the ruins a little longer!
You can confirm the place to start\nthe next mission from [64ffff]Menu[ffffff] > [64ffff]Status[ffffff] > [64ffff]Quests[ffffff].
We recommend that you play missions first.\nWhen you get used to the game, try other quests!
